Description
: Add antique charm to your collection with this set of 5 vintage glass utility electric pole insulators in clear and blue hues. These authentic insulators, once used on electrical poles to support wires, showcase time-tested craftsmanship with durable molded glass. The set includes three clear and two blue pieces, varying in size and shape, offering both visual interest and historical value. Each insulator features authentic wear and embossed lettering, echoing its original industrial use while providing a distinctive look for display or creative repurposing. Ideal for collectors, decorators, or anyone seeking unique antique decor, these glass insulators offer both decorative and historical appeal. Backed by our commitment to authenticity, these vintage glass pieces are sustainably sourced and perfect for adding character to your home or collection.

277396849.description: This mixed lot weighs approximately 4.2lbs and includes collectible minerals, crystals, and fossils. The set features polished and rough stones, geodes with purple and clear crystals, a quartz crystal point, and a quartz crystal cluster. Included is a specimen of coprolite (dinosaur poop) estimated to be around 50 million years old. Additional items include tumbled stones, an obsidian arrowhead, and various unique mineral specimens in multiple colors and shapes. All items are in good used or natural condition with no obvious damage, suitable for collectors, educational use, or display.

277695210.description:
Natural Mineral Specimens
Comprehensive Geological & Decorative Rock Collection
Natural Crystal, Polished Agate, and Identified Mineral Set
Largest piece approx. 9" x 8" | Total weight 8 lbs
Natural Specimens
This diverse geological collection features a substantial white crystal cluster exhibiting complex geometric terminations and a rugged natural matrix. Complementing the central specimen is a polished blue agate slice with concentric banding and a central crystalline pocket. The lot includes a vintage educational mineral set containing twenty distinct specimens-such as Obsidian, Petrified Wood, and Fluorite-each accompanied by descriptive geological data. An extensive assortment of raw and tumbled gemstones in various colors and textures provides a broad survey of mineralogy suitable for display or study.
Identification set includes specimens from regional locales including Arizona, Brazil, and Colorado.
Large crystal cluster showcases prominent tabular crystal growth and lustrous surfaces.
Agate slice features a vibrant teal-dyed hue highlighting the natural chalcedony layers.
Collection includes a wide variety of silicate and carbonate minerals in tumbled and raw forms.
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Natural mineral specimens show expected inclusions, varied textures, and minor surface friability inherent to their geological formation. The identification box and key show light shelf wear consistent with age but remain fully legible and intact. Agate slice and tumbled stones are well-polished.

277935583.description:
You are purchasing a "Large Clear Crystal Cluster Point Specimen" in "Used" condition.
Beautiful natural clear crystal cluster with multiple points, perfect as a display piece, decor accent, or addition to a mineral collection. The main point stands upright with a secondary point growing from the side, giving it a striking and sculptural look. Measured at roughly 6 inches tall and about 6 inches across at the widest point, this is a substantial specimen with a strong presence. The faces show natural clarity variations, internal veils, and inclusions that catch and diffuse the light. Brown mineral deposits on one side add character and a more rugged, earthy feel. This piece is ideal for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or anyone wanting a bold, natural centerpiece for a shelf, desk, or altar. Keywords: crystal cluster, clear crystal point, mineral specimen, quartz-style decor, rough crystal, natural stone decor, healing crystal, large crystal point
Condition Notes:
Crystal cluster shows natural rough edges, surface inclusions, and internal fractures. Some brown mineral deposits and discoloration are present on one side. Base is uneven and rough where the crystal has been broken from the matrix. Overall presents as an unpolished, natural specimen with visible wear consistent with extraction and handling.
